2131-2173-3698-4574--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2131-2173-3698-4574--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

240-4885-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

997-2577-4826-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
997-2577-4826-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

710-5617-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

586-3497-3899-5258-5618.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3240-5631-6462-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
3240-5631-6462-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

252-4231-5394-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5394-6633.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

654-1308-2557-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-1308-2557-4094-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

654-4365-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

372-413-4783.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Abdel Adrian, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Choose to have Abdel Adrian returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Hellkite Courser returns to the battlefield from exile, triggering itself and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger, putting Abdel Adrain from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Hellkite Courser and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each exiled permanent.
Resolve a Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a level counter on it

3457-5832-7791.description:
Activate Joraga Treespeaker by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Joraga Treespeaker.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Joraga Treespeaker.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Hourglass of the Lost

1636-4832-5371-7629.description:
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat
1636-4832-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

3464-3657-7488.description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Topiary Lecturer.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1409-4365-5423.description:
Activate Swashbuckler Extraordinaire by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
Resolve the Swashbuckler Extraordinaire trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2173-3845-5073-5220.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

944-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2530-2577-4506-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-4506-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness

2760-3143-4613-4762.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2760-3143-4613-4762.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Xavier Sal using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

560-2425-4550-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2425-4550-5256.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Smothering Abomination triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Repeat.

2060-2092-3921-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-3921-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1089-1339-6096.notablePrerequisites:
Curiosity attached to General Kreat.
You have a way to draw a card.
1089-1339-6096.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering General Kreat, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-4423-4863-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4423-4863-4872.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

232-2499-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Repeat.

1323-1719-3143-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Devoted Druid and Vizier of Tumbling Sands each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1323-1719-3143-4762.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

880-3875-4488.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4050-4952-5003.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
4050-4952-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Darksteel Splicer, adding {1}.
When Darksteel Splicer dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Darksteel Splicer from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Darksteel Splicer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least one 3/3 Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Phyrexian Golems, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If you have four or more opponents, this combo nets infinite creature tokens and colored mana.

215-380-803-2743.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Miirym triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Biovisionary to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Miirym triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1494-1971-4428.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with power five or greater, or you own a creature with power five or greater that is exiled by Yannik.
1494-1971-4428.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Yannik.
Yannik leaves the battlefield, causing any permanents exiled by it to re-enter the battlefield under their owner's control.
Yannik enters the battlefield, exiling a nontoken creature you control with power five or greater until Yannik leaves the battlefield, and putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1667-1744-3096-3994.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other Golems.
1667-1744-3096-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Leap by paying {U}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems each trigger.
Resolve the first Percursor Golem trigger, creating a copy of Leap targeting every other Golem.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the first Leap, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 10 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

800-2470-3263.notablePrerequisites: Knacksaw Clique does not have summoning sickness.
800-2470-3263.description:
Activate Grand Architect's first ability making Knacksaw Clique blue until end of turn.
Tap Knacksaw Clique to add {C}{C}.
Untap Knacksaw Clique, exiling the top card of target opponent's library.
Repeat steps 2-3.
